name: ai-native-framework
description: AI 原生研发交付引擎：issue 即状态，PR 即交付，证据可复算

scripts.build:engine: cd apps/engine && export GOPATH="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go" && export GOCACHE="${GOCACHE:-$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go-build}" && mkdir -p ../../.cache/bin && go build -o ../../.cache/bin/engine ./cmd/engine
scripts.check: npm run check:state && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:go && npm run check:engine && npm run check:web
scripts.check:go: cd apps/api-go && test -z "$(gofmt -l *.go)" && export GOPATH="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go" && export GOCACHE="${GOCACHE:-$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go-build}" && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.check:engine: cd apps/engine && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && export GOPATH="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go" && export GOCACHE="${GOCACHE:-$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go-build}" && go vet ./... && go test ./...
scripts.api: cd apps/api-go && export GOPATH="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go" && export GOCACHE="${GOCACHE:-$(cd ../.. && pwd)/.cache/go-build}" && go run .
